mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('PENDING', 'CANCELED') GROUP BY member_id ) o ON o.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o2.member_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_amount FROM payment p JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'DONE' GROUP BY o2.member_id ) pay ON pay.member_id = m.id

where.if: AND (m.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.email, m.nickname, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(pay.total_payment_amount, 0) AS total_payment_amount FROM member m
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.member_id = m.id AND o.status NOT IN ('PENDING', 'CANCELED')) AS order_count,
COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = p.order_id WHERE o2.member_id = m.id AND p.status = 'DONE'), 0) AS total_payment_amount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_coupon mc2 JOIN coupon c ON c.id = mc2.coupon_id WHERE mc2.member_id = m.id AND mc2.used = 0 AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.expires_at > #{now}) AS usable_coupon_count FROM member m WHERE m.id = #{memberId}
